name: Stack Exchange API
tier_rationale: Stack Exchange, Inc., an established company with published API terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

stackexchange.description: Stack Exchange API application key (raises the daily quota from 300 per IP to 10,000)

users_api.title: Stack Exchange API 2.3 users (site=stackoverflow) and users/{account_id}/associated

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

users_api.notes: Research C0273 + live check 2026-11-26: keyless quota 300 requests/day per IP (the shared egress showed 233-285 left), 10,000/day with the free key 'stackexchange'. error_id 502 throttle_violation = RATE_LIMITED (QUOTA when the wait exceeds 1 h); the 'backoff' field is honoured before the next call. User content is CC BY-SA 4.0: shown with attribution (P116 FC8). Display names are not unique: a name search lists nothing when several accounts match.

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P116 stackexchange_user). The keyless per-IP quota is shared by every user of the egress: the budget uses at most a third of it (safety_margin 0.33).
